sara_sales: passing the Acela Systems trial over to CS — quick context and risks

sara_sales: Context: POC started Mon, goal is support-summary + redaction. They expect ~100k tokens/day at peak. Currently using hosted API but they've flagged latency and compliance.
- Primary contact: Alex (CTO) alex@acela.com
- Current setup: hosted, model: open-mistral-7b-quant (client called it "mistral-quant")
- Pain points: long-doc inputs >8k tokens sometimes truncate / cause errors; legal asking about on-prem/HIPAA; SSO (SAML) not provisioned.
- Renewal signal: medium risk — legal preference for private deploy could push them to vendor if we can't show a plan N-90.

Action request: @jordan_cs take onboarding lead; @lee_support reproduce infra failure and open infra ticket; @ana_eng to triage model/kv-cache behavior if needed. I attached the PRD link (sensitive info to be shared in one-on-one): https://redwood.share/priv/AcelaPRD

jordan_cs: thanks Sara — picking this up. First steps from CS side: 1) schedule kickoff with Alex and invite Lee + Ana, 2) request SAML metadata + SSO test account, 3) repro the long-doc behavior and capture logs, 4) prepare a provisional timeline + dedicated estimate if infra required.

jordan_cs: i'll create the onboarding checklist in our runbooks and tag owners. Tentative kickoff Wed 10am PT unless customer requests otherwise.

lee_support: created INF-3241 for the long-doc truncation/OOMs. Repro notes in ticket: client sends ~12k token doc, generation stops mid-output, backend logs show kv-cache OOM on quantized path.

lee_support: INF-3241 link: https://redwood.atl/INF-3241 (added Alex's tracer logs, sanitized). I'll try to attach a minimized failing payload.

ana_eng: thanks — @lee_support can you paste a sanitized failing payload here or into the ticket? prefer one that reproduces within 2-3 steps. Curious about the sequence length distribution + model shard settings.

ana_eng: initial thought: quant4 runtime plus aggressive kv caching might be hitting a boundary — I can add a guard for very long sequences, and benchmark with a small patch.

sara_sales: sharing a sanitized sample via DM to Jordan and Lee. Note: customer said they could toggle to a non-quantized variant but worried about cost. Legal will probably ask for private deployment options.

deploy-bot: Dedicated request submitted for Acela Systems. Request ID DED-7788. Status: pending-qualification.

jordan_cs: proposed owner matrix and next steps — please confirm: Jordan (CS) owner for onboarding & customer comms; Lee (Support) owner for infra repro + ticket owner; Ana (Eng) owner for model fix and bench; Sara (Sales) owner for commercial/legal liaison.

jordan_cs: onboarding plan (short): 1) SSO creds + kickoff, 2) reproduce & mitigations (rate limit / temp truncation handling), 3) dedicated feasibility & estimate DED-7788, 4) capture feedback and update renewal health.

lee_support: +1. I'll prioritize INF-3241 and post ETA in the ticket by EOD tomorrow.

ana_eng: will schedule a quick bench tomorrow afternoon. If I find a safe kv-cache guard, i'll open a PR and mention INF-3241.

sara_sales: thanks — i'll confirm customer availability for kickoff and share legal doc requirements. Jordan — can you please log the renewal flag in Gainsight?

jordan_cs: will log renewal N-90 watch and create a Gainsight note with risks + legal ask. adding CS runbook placeholder: https://redwood.runbooks/acela-onboarding

sara_sales: no blockers from sales side right now. please keep me looped on any timeline impacts so I can manage expectations. :handshake:

jordan_cs: got it. i'll start the kickoff invite and post the meeting notes in the ticket.

lee_support: quick note — if we need a temporary mitigation, we can add a server-side prefix-trim before generation to keep token counts within safe bounds. I'll include that in INF-3241 as a suggestion.

ana_eng: agreed. will validate perf/regression impact.

sara_sales: appreciated — tagging everyone: @jordan_cs @lee_support @ana_eng. End of handoff for now.
